title: Assemble independent order regression scenarios
objective: Deliver an executable regression package for the supplied Order state machine. Each independent work unit contributes one scenario; the platform produces a unittest suite, verifies the correct implementation, and checks nine private behavioral faults.

tasks.title: Repeated capture must fail
tasks.description: Design one short regression scenario exercising this behavior: Repeated capture must fail.
tasks.requirements: Return one JSON scenario, not a test suite or program. The scenario must match the supplied correct implementation and expose the stated behavioral regression. Use total_cents integer in [1,1000000000], 1–12 actions, and refund amounts that are integers or booleans with absolute value <=1000000000. Actions are {op:"capture"}, {op:"cancel"}, or {op:"refund",amount:...}. Start with Order(total_cents); stop at the first ValueError. expected is either the entire final summary() dictionary or {error:"ValueError",at_step:zero_based_index}.

shape.expected: final summary object or ValueError/at_step object
